Updates `electron` from 6.1.7 to 6.1.12
Release notes

Sourced from electron's releases.

electron v43.2.0

Release Notes for v43.2.0

Features

  • Added net.WebSocket, a WHATWG-compatible WebSocket client for the main process that routes through Chromium's network stack. #52344 (Also in 42)

Fixes

  • Fixed app.disableHardwareAcceleration() not fully disabling GPU hardware usage on Windows starting from Electron 38. #52369 (Also in 41, 42, 44)
  • Fixed globalShortcut not working on GNOME Wayland by enabling Chromium's GlobalShortcutsPortalPreferredTrigger feature by default on Linux. #52228
  • Fixed a crash when showing Linux message boxes while another Linux UI implementation was active. #52410 (Also in 42, 44)
  • Fixed a window being marked hidden and background-throttled on macOS when covered by a transparent or click-through window. #52389 (Also in 44)
  • Fixed unnecessary autofill popup creation for fields without datalist suggestions, which could cause input latency on macOS. #52321 (Also in 41, 42, 44)
  • Fixed webContents.print() returning "Invalid printer settings" when print options are provided. #52381 (Also in 44)

Other Changes

  • Updated Chromium to 150.0.7871.129. #52355

electron v43.1.1

Release Notes for v43.1.1

Fixes

  • Fixed a browser-process crash (ValidateIntegrityOrDie) and spurious preload ENOENT errors when an app's app.asar is replaced on disk (e.g. by an updater or MDM software) while the app is running. #52293 (Also in 42, 44)

Other Changes

  • Updated Chromium to 150.0.7871.114. #52297

Breaking changes will be documented here, and deprecation warnings added to JS code where possible, at least one major version before the change is made.

Types of Breaking Changes

This document uses the following convention to categorize breaking changes:

  • API Changed: An API was changed in such a way that code that has not been updated is guaranteed to throw an exception.
  • Behavior Changed: The behavior of Electron has changed, but not in such a way that an exception will necessarily be thrown.
  • Default Changed: Code depending on the old default may break, not necessarily throwing an exception. The old behavior can be restored by explicitly specifying the value.

  • Removed: An API or feature was removed, and is no longer supported by Electron.

Planned Breaking API Changes (30.0)

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('app', {

threads.title: Launch Electron against app directory to fix startup crash
threads.author: Copilot
threads.body:
The app failed to open: on startup it errored with `App version is not a valid semver version: "0.0"`, thrown by `electron-updater` before the main window loaded.

## Root cause
The `start` script pointed Electron at the main **file** (`./app/main`) instead of the app **directory**. Given a file path, Electron skips `app/package.json`, so:
- `app.getName()` → `"Electron"` (wrong identity → wrong `userData` path)
- `app.getVersion()` → Electron's own/invalid version instead of `2.8.6`

The invalid version makes `electron-updater` throw during the `ready` event, aborting startup.

## Change
- `package.json`: launch the directory so Electron loads `app/package.json` (`main: main.js`), restoring the correct name and a valid semver version.

```diff
-    "start": "electron ./app/main",
+    "start": "electron ./app",
```

Config-only change; no application code modified.

threads.author: grepmykeys
threads.body:
## Summary
This PR modernizes the MZD-AIO-TI application by upgrading to Electron 29.4.6 and updating all dependencies to current versions. The changes include migrating to the new `@electron/remote` module, updating deprecated Electron APIs, and improving security configurations.

## Key Changes

### Electron and Dependency Updates
- Upgraded Electron from 6.1.9 to 29.4.6
- Updated electron-builder from 21.2.0 to 24.13.3
- Updated extract-zip from 1.7.0 to 2.0.1 (callback-based to Promise-based API)
- Updated node-abi from 2.15.0 to 3.67.0
- Updated xml2js from 0.4.23 to 0.6.2
- Updated jQuery from 3.4.1 to 3.7.1
- Updated Node.js engine requirement from ^13 to ^18 || ^20 || ^22

### API Migrations
- Migrated from deprecated `electron.remote` to `@electron/remote` module with explicit initialization
- Replaced `dialog.showMessageBox()` with `dialog.showMessageBoxSync()` for synchronous behavior
- Replaced `dialog.showOpenDialog()` callback-based API with Promise-based async/await pattern
- Replaced deprecated `crashed` event with `render-process-gone` event with detailed error information
- Replaced `new-window` event handler with `setWindowOpenHandler()` API
- Updated `extract-zip` usage from callback to Promise-based `.then()/.catch()` pattern

### Security Improvements
- Added `contextIsolation: true` to info window and download window webPreferences
- Set `contextIsolation: false` explicitly for windows using preload scripts (main and imageJoin windows)
- Enabled `@electron/remote` on specific webContents instead of globally
- Changed window open handler to deny all new windows opened by renderer code

### Build and Release Configuration
- Updated repository URLs from Trevelopment/MZD-AIO to upstateautomate/MZD-AIO
- Updated homepage from mazdatweaks.com to GitHub repository
- Consolidated Windows build targets (removed 32-bit build)
- Centralized publish configuration to GitHub releases
- Removed legacy Bintray publish configurations
- Added GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows for automated testing and releases

### Code Cleanup
- Removed numerous commented-out debug code blocks
- Removed unused devtron dependency
- Removed legacy Squirrel startup event handling
- Simplified error handling and logging
- Updated postinstall script to use @electron/rebuild
